Discover clone leaves: smoothed PCA + Ward tree over-cut

Source: R/clones_discovery.R
discover_clones.Rd

irlba PCA of the centred feature matrix, kNN smoothing of the PCs (mean over each cell and its k neighbours, FNN), Ward.D2 hclust on the smoothed PCs, cut at max_leaves; leaves smaller than min_size are merged into the nearest leaf (centroid distance). The leaves over-split on purpose; merge_clones() merges them back with a calibrated test.

Usage

discover_clones(X, n_pc = 20, k = 20, max_leaves = 40, min_size = 20, seed = 1)

Arguments

X

cells x features matrix (clone_feature_matrix())

n_pc

principal components

k

neighbours for the smoothing

max_leaves

leaves of the over-cut

min_size

minimal leaf size (cells)

seed

RNG seed

Value

list(tree = hclust, leaves = named integer labels (names = cells), pc, smooth)
